title: Capstone dogfood: author a basic Flash game end-to-end and verify in Ruffle
description: North-star MVP acceptance test. Using only the authoring tool (UI or JSFL automation bridge — no hand-written SWF bytes): draw shapes, create symbols incl. a Button, animate on the timeline, write AS2 (onEnterFrame game loop, Key input, MovieClip.hitTest, score in a TextField, gotoAndStop for game-over), publish the SWF, and verify it is actually playable in Ruffle using the interactivity oracle (0518). A simple avoider/pong/catcher is enough. Every gap or bug discovered becomes a new task. The MVP is not done until this task passes. Blocked by 0517 (button actions) and 0518 (interactivity oracle).
